Asha: Quick FYI — PTQ bringup for ranklight-3b shows weird NDCG up for long-docs (>2k chars) but down for short ones. baseline vs ptq: longdocs 0.487->0.512, short 0.623->0.599
Ben: That's odd. PTQ usually hurts tail more. Did you change candidate preprocessing or tokenization?
Asha: No direct token change on model path, but we switched embedder->reranker handoff to use serialized passages (proto v2) last week. QA-bot: run=3523, artifacts at https://ci.redwood.internal/artifacts/3523
Ravi: Can you paste the eval command you used?
Asha: rankbench run --model ranklight-3b-ptq --cohorts longdocs,shortqueries --candidates 200 --seed 7 --normalize false
Ben: normalize=false stands out. Our baseline runs always set normalize=true when comparing NDCG because of varying doc lengths.
Asha: Ah — I wanted raw-scores to inspect distribution, forgot normalizing affects rank aggregation. Re-ran with normalize=true: longdocs 0.495, short 0.605 (so delta smaller but still short-query drop).
Ravi: Hmm. Could still be tokenization/casing mismatch between serialized proto and reranker tokenizer. I remember proto v2 lowercases passage titles for storage.
Asha: Confirmed: proto v2 sets title = title.lower(). Body kept as-is.
Ben: That could bump long-doc scoring (title signal lost -> body matters more) while short queries relying on exact match to title drop.
QA-bot: "artifact: token-diff.csv" uploaded for run 3523
Asha: Quick inspect: for short queries (Q="Install Docker on Mac") baseline top1 included doc with title "Install Docker on macOS" but PTQ-serialized title became "install docker on macos" and scoring mismatch because reranker encoder was pretrained with case-sensitive tokens.
Ravi: PTQ model quantization may have reduced sensitivity to subtle casing patterns; combined with proto lowercasing we get non-linear effect.
Ben: Two-pronged fix: 1) revert proto v2 title lowercasing for now; 2) add a small normalization toggle in rankbench to run both normalized and raw NDCG automatically.
Asha: I'm going to re-run a ~5k sample with proto revert + normalize=true and post numbers. ETA ~30min.
Ravi: Also file a follow-up to test PTQ model on case-augmented golden set (caps/no-caps) — we need to surface case-robustness regression in CI.
Ben: I'll add a cheap unit test in candidate-serializer to assert titles are preserved.
Asha: Action items: (Asha) re-run with proto revert; (Ben) PR for serializer test; (Ravi) add case-augmented golden set to quicksanity.
QA-bot: "ci: proto v2 change reverted on canary at 2026-03-18T14:02:12Z"
Asha: Re-run started: will drop results here.
Ben: Nice catch — casing + normalize flag combo is a classic gotcha. :celebrate:
